mechanism: Betamethasone may increase gastrointestinal side effects of rivastigmine and potentially increase cholinergic effects; corticosteroids can also impair cognition which may counteract rivastigmine's therapeutic benefit.
action: Monitor for increased GI adverse effects (nausea, vomiting, diarrhea) and cognitive changes; use lowest effective betamethasone dose and shortest duration; consider alternative anti-inflammatory agents when possible.
